name: WarehouseWavePlanner
tagline: Pick waves planned against every carrier cut-off – zone workload, ETA and slack, release rules and floor progress in one app.
description: A complete pick-wave planning app for DCs, e-commerce fulfilment and 3PL warehouses in one Power Apps code component: builds waves from the outbound order pool by carrier and cut-off (express and critical first), estimates each wave's pick time per zone from lines, pickers and pick rate, shows ETA and slack against the cut-off after the pack & load buffer, and runs release (dock door, wave size, carrier mix, floor limit, cut-off feasibility with supervisor override), split, recall, progress, confirm picked, ship and holds.
features: Build waves by carrier cut-off and priority
Finite-capacity zone queue with ETA and slack
Split waves by lines or zone
Progress, short picks, confirm picked and ship
Zone workload until the last cut-off
Wave sheets, bulk actions, undo, CSV and wave-plan JSON
Demo mode with a fictional fulfilment DC
